name: Lust Disciples
genericName: Lust Disciples||Aspirants of Perfection||Aspirants of Ly'shir
background:
Havoc Disciples are Battle Brothers who have embraced the worship of a particular Havoc God. Individually powerful and resilient, each Havoc Disciple has been molded with unique blessings by the god they follow. 

Stranded in the Sirius Sector, many Battle Brothers were scattered and left with little chance of survival. These desperate castaways were approached by different gods who offered powerful boons in exchange for their worship. Each god empowered their respective followers, reforging their Disciples according to their will. The Havoc Disciples are now torn between fanatical devotion to their new gods and maintaining their former discipline.
backgroundFull:
On arriving in the Sirius Sector, the Founder’s fleet was scattered and damaged. Most of these ships and their crews were discounted as destroyed, but had in fact arrived safely in Sirius far from the rest of humanity. Many believed themselves to be the sole survivors of the fleet and that they were likely the only humans in this strange new galaxy. Without any idea of how they might return to Earth, most of the scattered Battle Brothers were forced to contend with their inevitable deaths in a strange new galaxy.

Humanity was not alone in this galaxy however, and the arrival of these strange interlopers drew the eyes of powerful entities in Sirius: the Havoc Gods. These gods bided their time and reached out to the Battle Brothers in their most desperate moments. Each Havoc God sought to sway these new arrivals to their influence through various gifts and boons.

The God of War offered strength, allowing its Disciples to triumph over their foes. Change granted its followers knowledge and secrets, necessary for understanding their place in this new galaxy. Plague offered renewed vitality to those taken by disease. While Lust offered redemption and power to those cast out by the Battle Brothers. 

Those who accepted the pact were granted powerful boons by their patrons, who reforged them in their image. These Havoc Disciples repaid their gifts with a fanatical loyalty, willing to devote their lives to the god who had chosen them. Disciples began to seek each other out, forming new bands utterly dedicated to their respective god. 

Yet the fanaticism demanded by their faith was often at odds with the discipline required to maintain their cohesion as a unit. While some Disciples recognized organization as a necessary means to achieving their God’s goals against powerful foes, others viewed it as a mere distraction, and cared little about structure that once defined their lives as Battle Brothers. As a result, many bands are held together through brute force, as leaders struggle to preserve order amongst fanatics. Others have collapsed into marauding hordes of zealots, roving blindly through the sector as they spread havoc in the name of their god.

How will your devotion guide you?

specialRules.name: Lustbound
specialRules.description: Moves +1" when using Advance, and +2" when using Rush/Charge.

specialRules.name: Enhanced Lustbound
specialRules.description: If this model has Lustbound, it moves +2" on Advance and +4" on Rush/Charge from Lustbound (instead of only +1" and +2").

specialRules.name: Steadfast Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get Steadfast. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Unpredictable
specialRules.description: When attacking, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1), and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.

specialRules.name: Defense
specialRules.description: This model gets +X to Defense rolls.

specialRules.name: Mend
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly model within 3" with Tough, and remove D3 wounds from it.

specialRules.name: Melee Evasion
specialRules.description: Enemies get -1 to hit rolls in melee when attacking units where most models have this rule.

specialRules.name: Spell Resistance Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get Spell Resistance. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Furious Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get Furious. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Relentless Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get Relentless. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Scout Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get Scout. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Enhanced Lustbound Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get Enhanced Lustbound. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Versatile Expert
specialRules.description: When this unit is activated, pick one effect: until the end of the activation all models with this rule in this unit either get AP(+1) when attacking, or get +1 to hit rolls when attacking.

specialRules.name: Heavy Impact
specialRules.description: Counts as having Impact(X) with hits that have AP(1).

specialRules.name: Quick Shot
specialRules.description: This model may shoot after using Rush actions.

specialRules.name: Ignores Cover
specialRules.description: This weapon ignores Cover.

specialRules.name: Scourge
specialRules.description: For each unmodified result of 1 to block hits, this weapon counts as having dealt 2 extra wounds when checking who won melee, or if shooting wounds would trigger Morale Tests.

specialRules.name: Crossing Strike
specialRules.description: Once per activation, when this model moves through enemy units, pick one of them and attack it with this weapon as if it was shooting. This weapon may only be used in this way.

specialRules.name: Unpredictable Fighter
specialRules.description: When in melee, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1), and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.

specialRules.name: Versatile Defense Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get Versatile Defense. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Dangerous Terrain Debuff
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick up to 3 enemy units within 18" in line of sight, which counts as being in Dangerous terrain once (next time the effect would apply).

specialRules.name: Obliterate
specialRules.description: Ignores Regeneration, and when attacking units where most models have Tough(27) or higher, the target must re-roll successful unmodified Defense results of 5-6.

specialRules.name: Agile
specialRules.description: Moves +1" when using Advance, and +2" when using Rush/Charge.

specialRules.name: Enhanced Agile
specialRules.description: If this model has Agile, it moves +2" on Advance and +4" on Rush/Charge from Agile (instead of only +1" and +2").

specialRules.name: Steadfast
specialRules.description: If a unit where most models have this rule is Shaken at the beginning of the round, roll one die. On a 4+, it stops being Shaken.

specialRules.name: AP
specialRules.description: Targets get -X to Defense rolls when blocking hits.

specialRules.name: Tough
specialRules.description: Once a model has taken as many wounds as its Tough value, it is killed (remove from play).

specialRules.name: Spell Resistance
specialRules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 6+ it is ignored. If the wounds were from a spell, then they are ignored on a 2+ instead.

specialRules.name: Furious
specialRules.description: When charging, unmodified result of 6 to hit deal 1 extra hit (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules).

specialRules.name: Relentless
specialRules.description: When this model shoots at enemies over 9” away, unmodified result of 6 to hit deal 1 extra hit (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules).

specialRules.name: Scout
specialRules.description: This model may be placed anywhere within 12” after being deployed.

specialRules.name: Impact
specialRules.description: When charging, before either unit attacks, roll X dice, unless this unit is Fatigued. For each 2+ the target takes 1 hit.

specialRules.name: Versatile Defense
specialRules.description: As long as a unit where most models have this rule hasn't activated yet this round, pick one effect when it is attacked: the unit either gets +1 to Defense rolls, or enemy units get -1 to hit rolls against it. Note that you may pick a different effect each time the unit is attacked.

specialRules.name: Regeneration
specialRules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 5+ it is ignored.

specialRules.name: Ignores Regeneration
specialRules.description: This weapon ignores Regeneration.

specialRules.name: Shred
specialRules.description: For each unmodified result of 1 to block hits, this weapon deals 1 extra wound.
